trainer.dialogueBefore: Guitarist Tony: The waves keep the beat and I play along. Here comes the loud part!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Guitarist Tony: Out of tune and out of luck. I'll go back to playing for the gulls.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Sailor Skyler: Months at sea, and dry land still rocks under my feet! Battle me while I find my legs!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Sailor Skyler: Bah! Give me a rolling deck any day. I fight better with the sea under me.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Fisherman Miguel: Shh, you'll frighten the fish! ...A battle? Go on, then, but keep it quiet.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Fisherman Miguel: Lost the battle, and the fish have all swum off. Not my day.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Fisherman Luc: Every one of my Pokémon came up out of this water on the end of my line!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Fisherman Luc: I'll cast again. There's always something bigger down there.
